scope.observational_law: entire prefix-generated sequence after fit-specific OOV collapse, conditional on observed length
scope.outer_model_search_status: post-outcome; numerical weight selection uses outer training only, but the mixture family and matched comparison were motivated by exposed v1/v2 outcomes
scope.conditional_intervals: component bootstrap conditions on fitted predictors and chosen folds; it does not include family-search or training-estimation uncertainty
scope.target_free_weight_selection: one constant weight per fold selected with inner pooled likelihood; no per-target gate or target-defined stratum chooses it
